title: More in her line
html_source: Well she is about to commit adultery!

anchor.prefix:
pened it. Thought so. 

 A woman's voice behind the dingy curtain. Listen: the man. 

 No: she wouldn't like that much. Got her it once. 

 He read the other title: Sweets of Sin.
anchor.suffix:
. Let us see. 

 He read where his finger opened. 

— All the dollarbills her husband gave her were spent in the stores on wondrous gowns and costliest frillies. For him! For Raoul
